[MasterScythe] Just a reminder, that if this is your first restore and protect fill, even if you're usually the type to be OK with 10k or 15k oil changes - dont risk that.
It releases so much grit and carbon flake that your filter can bypass early and you just end up circulating all that grit.
First fill should be 5k-7.5k.
I cut all my filters open, this whole new trick of using esters to crack the carbon off the metal is very cool, but HOO BOY does it get THICK and 'sandy' in the filter.
[boozed] Thanks for the tip, that could certainly be alarming if you weren't expecting it
